Two are the documented high-contrast pairs: Hearth on Ember (BUTTON_PRIMARY rest, text-stone-900 on bg-rose-400, 6.11:1) and Chalk on Scorch Rule (BUTTON_DANGER hover, text-stone-50 on bg-red-900, 9.60:1). Disabled text is exempt from WCAG 1.4.3 (inactive components) and is deliberately dim. The html.ts and shell.ts waivers that used to sit beside this one were removed the same day: under impeccable 4.5 their pairings (near-white Chalk on Scorch Deep and on Ember Deep) are no longer reported, so they silenced nothing, and a waiver that silences nothing would hide the next real hit in those files. This waiver must stay value:"*" — gray-on-color emits no ignoreValue, so per-pair waiving is not possible. The hit COUNT above is therefore the tripwire: if `scripts/impeccable detect --no-config src/views` reports more hits in this file than stated, something new is being silenced and the reason needs re-deriving.
